title: Ode to Joy (theme of the finale of Symphony No. 9), arranged in six sections

passes.label: the loom wakes: drone, heartbeat kick, clatter; no melody
statement 1, theme alone in the bass register: one indigo thread
statement 2, theme in the tenor with a counter-line: a silver thread joins
statement 3, theme in violins and lead synth: gold arrives
statement 4, tutti: every colour, the tapestry completes
final cadence, broadening ritardando into one big hit

lyrics.en: Joy, beautiful spark of the gods,
Joy, beautiful spark of the gods,
Joy, beautiful spark of the gods,
